name: Sofia Ramirez
bio:
Sofia Ramirez discovered her passion for motorsport unexpectedly, while catering a small regional race event in her hometown. The energy of the track and the dedication of the teams captivated her, sparking a desire to combine her culinary skills with the fast-paced world of racing. Before joining Manthey Racing, Sofia honed her skills at several high-end restaurants, mastering the art of delivering exceptional food under pressure.

As Catering Manager for Manthey Racing, Sofia is responsible for ensuring the team is well-fed and energized throughout the race season. She meticulously plans menus that cater to dietary restrictions and preferences, always prioritizing fresh, local ingredients. Sofia's calm demeanor and resourcefulness make her an invaluable asset, especially during the hectic race weekends. Her signature dishes, like her meticulously crafted mole poblano, have become a team favorite, bringing a touch of home to the track.

What sets Sofia apart is her unwavering commitment to quality and her ability to adapt to constantly changing circumstances. Whether it's sourcing last-minute ingredients or accommodating unexpected guests, she always finds a way to deliver exceptional service with a smile. She also has a knack for creating a positive and supportive atmosphere within the team, fostering camaraderie and boosting morale.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a neat bun
physical.description: Sofia is of average height with a warm, friendly smile and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down recipe ideas.
Insists on using fresh herbs grown in a small portable garden she brings to each race.
Has a habit of humming traditional Mexican folk songs while she's cooking.
